device.description: 12-bit low-power single-channel voltage-output DAC with external reference input, output feedback pin and 3-wire SPI-compatible interface
device.note: dac7513.pdf (SBAS157A) p.2 pin configurations (SOT23-8, MSOP-8), p.3 pin descriptions, p.4 power requirements (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.5 timing characteristics and serial write operation diagram, p.13 serial interface, power-on reset (zero), power-down modes (Table I), input shift register (Figure 3), SYNC interrupt (Figure 4)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; power-on reset fills it with zeros (0 V) until a valid write

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 (DB13/DB12) of the last valid frame, Table I (00 normal operation)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: DB15-DB14 don't care, DB13-DB12 PD1/PD0, DB11-DB0 data; executed on the 16th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high before it aborts the frame (SYNC interrupt)

pages: p.2 (pin configurations), p.3 (pin descriptions), p.4 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.5 (timing characteristics, serial write operation), p.13 (serial interface, power-on reset, power-down Table I, input shift register Figure 3)
notModeled: analog output, resistor string and output amplifier (VOUT never driven)
power-down output loads (1 kOhm / 100 kOhm / Hi-Z): PD1/PD0 are stored in CTRL.PD only
power-up time from power-down (2.5-5 us) and output settling
SCLK frequency (30 MHz / 20 MHz) and setup/hold limits t1-t8
VFB feedback pin (amplifier sense input, analog)
variants: DAC7513E (MSOP-8, DGK) and DAC7513N (SOT23-8, DCN): same die and 16-bit frame, different pin numbering. DAC7512 is the VDD-referenced version without VREF/VFB.
